name: PulseCoAP
description: No-heap CoAP (RFC 7252) client and server for constrained IoT devices. Fixed-buffer, zero-dynamic-allocation, with Observe (RFC 7641) push notifications, block-wise transfer (RFC 7959), resource discovery (RFC 6690), URI templates, separate responses, IPv6, and DTLS/CoAPs (RFC 6347) via mbedTLS PSK. Part of the Pulse embedded library ecosystem.
